configuration-properties.doc:name: Config Properties (dev)
configuration-properties.doc:description: Loads the base configuration properties file for the local/dev environment.

http:listener-config.name: api-httpListenerConfig
http:listener-config.doc:name: HTTP Listener Config
http:listener-config.doc:description: Shared HTTP listener configuration used by the APIkit router. Binds to all interfaces on the port defined in config.yaml.

http:request-config.name: fedex-httpRequestConfig
http:request-config.doc:name: FedEx HTTP Request Config
http:request-config.doc:description: Outbound HTTP connection to the FedEx Tracking REST API. Base URL and timeout are read from config.yaml.

http:request-config.name: ups-httpRequestConfig
http:request-config.doc:name: UPS HTTP Request Config
http:request-config.doc:description: Outbound HTTP connection to the UPS Tracking REST API. Base URL and timeout are read from config.yaml.

http:request-config.name: dhl-httpRequestConfig
http:request-config.doc:name: DHL HTTP Request Config
http:request-config.doc:description: Outbound HTTP connection to the DHL Shipment Tracking API. Base URL and timeout are read from config.yaml.

http:request-config.name: usps-httpRequestConfig
http:request-config.doc:name: USPS HTTP Request Config
http:request-config.doc:description: Outbound HTTP connection to the USPS Web Tools API. Base URL and timeout are read from config.yaml.

error-handler.name: global-error-handler
error-handler.doc:name: Global Error Handler
error-handler.doc:description: Application-level last-resort error handler. Returns a normalised ErrorResponse JSON body for any uncaught exception.

on-error-propagate.doc:name: Upstream Auth Error
on-error-propagate.doc:description: Handles authentication/authorisation errors from carrier API calls.

set-variable.doc:name: Set HTTP Status 502
set-variable.doc:description: Maps carrier auth errors to 502 Bad Gateway.

set-payload.value: #[%dw 2.0 output application/json --- { code: "UPSTREAM_AUTH_ERROR", message: "Authentication failure communicating with the upstream carrier API.", correlationId: correlationId }]
set-payload.doc:name: Set Error Payload
set-payload.doc:description: Builds the normalised ErrorResponse body for auth failures.

on-error-propagate.doc:name: Connectivity / Timeout Error
on-error-propagate.doc:description: Handles network timeouts and carrier API connectivity failures.

set-variable.doc:name: Set HTTP Status 503
set-variable.doc:description: Maps connectivity failures to 503 Service Unavailable.

set-payload.value: #[%dw 2.0 output application/json --- { code: "CARRIER_UNAVAILABLE", message: "A carrier API is temporarily unreachable. Please retry later.", correlationId: correlationId }]
set-payload.doc:name: Set Error Payload
set-payload.doc:description: Builds the normalised ErrorResponse body for connectivity failures.

on-error-propagate.doc:name: Catch-All Error
on-error-propagate.doc:description: Last-resort handler for any exception not caught by a more specific handler.

set-variable.doc:name: Set HTTP Status 500
set-variable.doc:description: Returns 500 Internal Server Error for all unhandled exceptions.

set-payload.value: #[%dw 2.0 output application/json --- { code: "INTERNAL_ERROR", message: "An unexpected error occurred. Please contact support with the correlation ID.", correlationId: correlationId }]
set-payload.doc:name: Set Error Payload
set-payload.doc:description: Builds the normalised ErrorResponse body for unexpected failures.
